items.text: {{S}} automatically uses strategies in a range of contexts to spell unfamiliar words.
{{S}} identifies complex letter patterns and sounds when spelling and applies this knowledge to improve spelling accuracy.

{{S}} applies correct spelling patterns and general rules when writing.
